# nginx
> Official NGINX site for the open source web server, reverse proxy, load balancer, mail proxy, and related documentation.

NGINX.org provides the primary documentation, download, security, and project resources for NGINX Open Source, including core module references, administration guides, njs scripting docs, and community information.

## Getting Started
- [NGINX Documentation](https://nginx.org/en/docs/): Main documentation hub for installation, configuration, modules, and administration.
- [Beginner’s Guide](https://nginx.org/en/docs/beginners_guide.html): Introductory guide to basic NGINX concepts, configuration, and operation.
- [Admin Guide](https://nginx.org/en/docs/): Central entry point for operational and configuration documentation.
- [FAQ](https://nginx.org/en/docs/faq.html): Answers to common questions about usage, features, and behavior.
- [Download](https://nginx.org/en/download.html): Official source code and package download information for NGINX releases.
- [News](https://nginx.org/news.html): Release announcements and notable project updates.

## Core Documentation
- [Documentation Index](https://nginx.org/en/docs/): Top-level index for all NGINX Open Source documentation.
- [Core Functionality](https://nginx.org/en/docs/): Overview of available documentation for server configuration and runtime behavior.
- [Command-Line Parameters](https://nginx.org/en/docs/switches.html): Reference for startup, reload, test, and signal handling options.
- [Control Interface](https://nginx.org/en/docs/control.html): How to manage master and worker processes with signals.
- [Variables Index](https://nginx.org/en/docs/varindex.html): Alphabetical index of embedded variables available in configuration.
- [Directive Index](https://nginx.org/en/docs/dirindex.html): Alphabetical index of configuration directives across modules.
- [Module Index](https://nginx.org/en/docs/modindex.html): Index of NGINX modules and their directive references.

## HTTP Modules Reference
- [HTTP Core Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_core_module.html): Reference for core HTTP server, location, and request processing directives.
- [HTTP Proxy Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_proxy_module.html): Directives for proxying requests to upstream HTTP servers.
- [HTTP Upstream Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_upstream_module.html): Configuration for upstream groups, balancing, and server parameters.
- [HTTP Rewrite Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_rewrite_module.html): URI rewriting, conditional logic, and return directives.
- [HTTP SSL Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html): TLS configuration for HTTPS servers and proxied connections.
- [HTTP Gzip Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_gzip_module.html): Response compression directives for HTTP traffic.
- [HTTP FastCGI Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_fastcgi_module.html): FastCGI proxying directives for application servers.
- [HTTP Access Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_access_module.html): Allow and deny access controls by client address.

## Stream and Mail Modules
- [Stream Core Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_core_module.html): Core directives for TCP and UDP proxying.
- [Stream Proxy Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_proxy_module.html): Proxy configuration for generic TCP and UDP services.
- [Stream SSL Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/stream/ngx_stream_ssl_module.html): TLS support for stream servers and proxied connections.
- [Mail Core Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_core_module.html): Core directives for mail proxy services.
- [Mail Proxy Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_proxy_module.html): Proxying configuration for IMAP, POP3, and SMTP.
- [Mail SSL Module](https://nginx.org/en/docs/mail/ngx_mail_ssl_module.html): TLS configuration for mail proxy services.

## Development and Extensibility
- [Development Guide](https://nginx.org/en/docs/dev/development_guide.html): Guide to NGINX internals, module development, and core APIs.
- [njs Documentation](https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/): Documentation for the NGINX JavaScript language and runtime.
- [njs Reference](https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/reference.html): API and language reference for njs in NGINX contexts.
- [njs Examples](https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/examples.html): Practical examples of scripting with njs in NGINX.
- [Dynamic Modules](https://nginx.org/en/docs/ngx_core_module.html#load_module): Directive reference for loading dynamic modules at runtime.
- [Source Download](https://nginx.org/en/download.html): Access to source tarballs for building and extending NGINX.

## Security and Releases
- [Security Advisories](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html): Official security notices and vulnerability information for NGINX.
- [CHANGES](https://nginx.org/en/CHANGES): Detailed changelog for mainline and stable NGINX releases.
- [CHANGES.ru](https://nginx.org/en/CHANGES.ru): Russian changelog for NGINX releases.
- [Download](https://nginx.org/en/download.html): Current mainline, stable, legacy, and source package downloads.
- [News](https://nginx.org/news.html): Release and project news from the official site.

## Community and Learning
- [Community](https://nginx.org/en/community.html): Community resources, contribution information, and communication channels.
- [Community Forum](https://community.nginx.org): Official community discussion forum for NGINX users and developers.
- [Books](https://nginx.org/en/books.html): Curated list of books covering NGINX administration and development.
- [Blog](https://blog.nginx.org/): Articles, tutorials, release posts, and engineering updates from the NGINX team.
- [FAQ](https://nginx.org/en/docs/faq.html): Frequently asked questions for users and administrators.
- [Russian Site](https://nginx.org/ru/): Russian-language version of the official NGINX site.

## Project and Ecosystem
- [About NGINX](https://nginx.org/en/): Overview of the NGINX project and open source software.
- [Enterprise](https://nginx.org/en/enterprise.html): Information about commercial NGINX offerings and support options.
- [Kubernetes Ingress Controller](https://github.com/nginx/kubernetes-ingress): Official NGINX Ingress Controller project for Kubernetes environments.
- [NGINX Gateway Fabric](https://github.com/nginx/nginx-gateway-fabric): Gateway API implementation for Kubernetes based on NGINX.
- [njs Project Docs](https://nginx.org/en/docs/njs/): Scripting ecosystem documentation for extending NGINX behavior.
- [X Account](https://x.com/nginxorg): Official social account for project announcements and updates.
